records.context: Three conventions apply.  image data channel numbers are zero-based and diameters are pixels, so values copied from one magnification are not portable without conversion.  The default v1 mask workflow preserves the directory layout expected by downstream tools; ``pipeline_style='v2'`` is opt-in and writes a different streaming layout.  Finally, removing UMAP cluster noise also removes those objects from the returned frame, keeping the table and the visible embedding aligned rather than silently returning different samples.
records.label: spacr.core#11
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three conventions apply.  Channel numbers are zero-based and diameters are pixels, so values copied from one magnification are not portable without conversion.  The default v1 mask pipeline preserves the directory layout expected by downstream tools; ``pipeline_style='v2'`` is opt-in and writes a different streaming layout.  Finally, removing UMAP cluster noise also removes those objects from the returned frame, keeping the table and the visible embedding aligned rather than silently returning different samples.
records.translation: Se aplican tres convenciones.  Los números de canal se basan en cero y los diámetros están en píxeles, por lo que los valores copiados de un aumento no son trasladables sin conversión.  El pipeline de máscaras v1 predeterminado conserva la estructura de directorios que esperan las herramientas posteriores; ``pipeline_style='v2'`` es opcional y escribe una estructura de streaming distinta.  Por último, eliminar el ruido de los clústeres de UMAP también elimina esos objetos del marco devuelto, de modo que la tabla y la proyección visible siguen alineadas en lugar de devolver sin aviso muestras distintas.

records.context: This landing page currently serves two spaCR tiles.  **Mask** runs :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` to turn raw multichannel acquisitions into preprocessed arrays and Cellpose masks for cells, nuclei, pathogens, and organelles.  **Image UMAP** runs :func:`generate_image_umap` to reduce measured single-object features, cluster them, and optionally place representative extracted image regions on the embedding.  The same module also exposes the timelapse-mask entry point; the two main workflows remain independent, and UMAP does not segment images.
records.label: spacr.core#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: This landing page currently serves two spaCR tiles.  **Mask** runs :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` to turn raw multichannel acquisitions into preprocessed arrays and Cellpose masks for cells, nuclei, pathogens, and organelles.  **Image UMAP** runs :func:`generate_image_umap` to reduce measured single-object features, cluster them, and optionally place representative image crops on the embedding.  The same module also exposes the timelapse-mask entry point; the two main workflows remain independent, and UMAP does not segment images.
records.translation: Esta página de inicio ofrece actualmente dos mosaicos de spaCR.  **Mask** ejecuta :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` para convertir adquisiciones multicanal sin procesar en matrices preprocesadas y máscaras de Cellpose para células, núcleos, patógenos y orgánulos.  **Image UMAP** ejecuta :func:`generate_image_umap` para reducir las características medidas de objetos individuales, agruparlas y, opcionalmente, colocar recortes de imagen representativos sobre la proyección.  El mismo módulo expone también el punto de entrada de máscaras de timelapse; los dos flujos de trabajo principales siguen siendo independientes, y UMAP no segmenta imágenes.

At least one segmentation channel must be enabled.  Start with ``dry_run=True`` to validate paths, channels, models, and the planned writes without loading a model or changing the project.
records.translation: La generación de máscaras necesita una o más carpetas de origen, un esquema de metadatos en los nombres de archivo (``cellvoyager`` o una expresión regular automática/personalizada), índices de canal basados en cero para los objetos que se van a segmentar, y diámetros de objeto y modelos adecuados. records.context: Image UMAP needs an existing ``measurements/measurements.db`` for every source, the object tables and features to include, and reduction/clustering settings. It embeds numeric measurements rather than raw pixels.  Thumbnail images come from the measured ``png_list`` table when ``crop_source='png'`` or are cut from ``merged/*.npy`` on demand when ``crop_source='merged'``; the latter is useful when measurement extracted image regions were not saved.
records.label: spacr.core#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Image UMAP needs an existing ``measurements/measurements.db`` for every source, the object tables and features to include, and reduction/clustering settings. It embeds numeric measurements rather than raw pixels.  Thumbnail images come from the measured ``png_list`` table when ``crop_source='png'`` or are cut from ``merged/*.npy`` on demand when ``crop_source='merged'``; the latter is useful when measurement crops were not saved.
records.translation: Image UMAP necesita un ``measurements/measurements.db`` existente para cada origen, las tablas de objetos y las características que se incluirán, y los ajustes de reducción y agrupamiento. Proyecta mediciones numéricas, no píxeles sin procesar.  Las miniaturas proceden de la tabla medida ``png_list`` cuando ``crop_source='png'`` o se recortan de ``merged/*.npy`` bajo demanda cuando ``crop_source='merged'``; esto último es útil cuando no se guardaron los recortes de la medición.

A dry run instead returns its preflight problem list.  Timelapse mask generation also writes movies and masks relabelled with track identities.

records.source: A normal Mask run writes preprocessed stacks, object masks, overlays and segmentation-QC artifacts, settings CSVs, counts in ``measurements.db``, and a run manifest beneath the source tree; it normally returns ``None``.  A dry run instead returns its preflight problem list.  Timelapse mask generation also writes movies and masks relabelled with track identities.
records.translation: Una ejecución normal de Mask escribe pilas preprocesadas, máscaras de objetos, superposiciones y artefactos de QC de la segmentación, CSV de ajustes, recuentos en ``measurements.db`` y un manifiesto de ejecución bajo el árbol de origen; normalmente devuelve ``None``.  Una ejecución de prueba devuelve en su lugar su lista de problemas de la comprobación previa. records.context: The thumbnails overlaid on the embedding come from whichever extracted-image-region source ``crop_source`` names: ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever an extracted image region folder exists) reads the pre-generated PNGs, ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no folder) cuts each one out of ``merged/*.npy`` on demand through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so the embedding can be drawn on a project that never kept an extracted image region folder — ``png_list`` is not required in that case. Either way the pixels arrive through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so a legacy (pre-341f446) extracted-image-region folder is image data channel-corrected on load and the montage shows the same image the Annotate application view does.
records.label: spacr.core.generate_image_umap#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The thumbnails overlaid on the embedding come from whichever crop source ``crop_source`` names: ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever a crop folder exists) reads the pre-generated PNGs, ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no folder) cuts each one out of ``merged/*.npy`` on demand through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so the embedding can be drawn on a project that never kept a crop folder — ``png_list`` is not required in that case. Either way the pixels arrive through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so a legacy (pre-341f446) crop folder is channel-corrected on load and the montage shows the same image the Annotate screen does.
records.translation: Las miniaturas superpuestas a la proyección proceden de la fuente de recortes que indique ``crop_source``: ``'png'`` (y ``'auto'`` siempre que exista una carpeta de recortes) lee los PNG generados previamente, mientras que ``'merged'`` (y ``'auto'`` sin carpeta) recorta cada una de ``merged/*.npy`` bajo demanda mediante :mod:`spacr.crops`, de modo que la proyección puede dibujarse en un proyecto que nunca conservó una carpeta de recortes — en ese caso no se requiere ``png_list``. En ambos casos los píxeles llegan a través de :mod:`spacr.crops`, de modo que una carpeta de recortes heredada (anterior a 341f446) se corrige por canal al cargarla y el montaje muestra la misma imagen que la pantalla Annotate.

records.translation: Dada una carpeta de origen ``src`` de imágenes multicanal, este pipeline (1) opcionalmente consolida entradas de carpetas anidadas, (2) renombra los archivos según la estructura de Yokogawa que se usa después, (3) preprocesa las matrices por canal, (4) genera máscaras para los canales de célula / núcleo / patógeno / orgánulo mediante Cellpose (variante SAM), (5) opcionalmente concilia la máscara celular con las superposiciones de núcleos + patógenos, y (6) escribe gráficos de superposición y un ``gen_mask_settings.csv`` junto a los resultados.

records.source: The returned DataFrame always contains the columns ``path`` and ``pred``. A single-logit head is converted with ``torch.sigmoid``, so ``pred`` is the positive-class probability; a multi-logit head is converted with ``torch.softmax``, so ``pred`` is the probability of class 1 for two classes and the winning class's confidence for more. With more than two classes the frame also carries ``predicted_label`` and one ``prob_class_<i>`` column per class. Results are also written to a CSV file derived from ``model_path`` and the current date.
records.translation: El DataFrame devuelto siempre contiene las columnas ``path`` y ``pred``. Una cabeza de un solo logit se convierte con ``torch.sigmoid``, de modo que ``pred`` es la probabilidad de la clase positiva; una cabeza de varios logits se convierte con ``torch.softmax``, de modo que ``pred`` es la probabilidad de la clase 1 cuando hay dos clases y la confianza de la clase ganadora cuando hay más. Con más de dos clases, el marco incluye también ``predicted_label`` y una columna ``prob_class_<i>`` por clase. Los resultados también se escriben en un archivo CSV cuyo nombre se deriva de ``model_path`` y de la fecha actual.

records.translation: La matriz de confusión se devuelve junto con cada cifra derivada, de modo que cada cifra de la ficha puede comprobarse con ella. The join structured-data name is chosen from ``prcfo``, ``png_path`` and ``file_name``, whichever matches the most rows, with ties going to ``prcfo``; a computed basename is not used. A structured-data name that arrives with two different values is written nowhere and counted, rows that cannot be placed are counted, and the merge runs in one transaction. See :mod:`spacr.predictions`.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Thin wrapper over :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions`, the merge path Classify (CV) and Classify (ML) share. The join key is chosen from ``prcfo``, ``png_path`` and ``file_name``, whichever matches the most rows, with ties going to ``prcfo``; a computed basename is not used. A key that arrives with two different values is written nowhere and counted, rows that cannot be placed are counted, and the merge runs in one transaction. See :mod:`spacr.predictions`.
records.translation: Envoltorio ligero sobre :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions`, la ruta de fusión que comparten Classify (CV) y Classify (ML). La clave de unión se elige entre ``prcfo``, ``png_path`` y ``file_name``, la que coincida con más filas, y en caso de empate gana ``prcfo``; no se usa un nombre base calculado. Una clave que llega con dos valores distintos no se escribe en ningún sitio y se contabiliza, las filas que no pueden ubicarse se contabilizan, y la fusión se ejecuta en una sola transacción. Véase :mod:`spacr.predictions`.

records.source: ``crop_source`` chooses where the pixels come from. ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever a crop folder exists) copies the pre-generated PNGs, unchanged. ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no crop folder) cuts each selected crop out of ``merged/*.npy`` through :mod:`spacr.crops` instead: the labels still come from ``png_list``, but the pixels are cut fresh at the current crop settings, so the training set costs no standing disk and cannot be built out of a folder that has gone stale. A project with no ``png_list`` at all falls back to the object measurement table, which still carries everything the metadata rules select on.
records.translation: ``crop_source`` elige de dónde proceden los píxeles. ``'png'`` (y ``'auto'`` siempre que exista una carpeta de recortes) copia los PNG generados previamente, sin cambios. ``'merged'`` (y ``'auto'`` sin carpeta de recortes) recorta en su lugar cada recorte seleccionado de ``merged/*.npy`` mediante :mod:`spacr.crops`: las etiquetas siguen procediendo de ``png_list``, pero los píxeles se recortan de nuevo con los ajustes de recorte actuales, de modo que el conjunto de entrenamiento no ocupa disco de forma permanente y no puede construirse a partir de una carpeta obsoleta. Un proyecto sin ningún ``png_list`` recurre a la tabla de mediciones de objetos, que sigue conteniendo todo aquello sobre lo que seleccionan las reglas de metadatos.

records.context: Target share of samples to hold out, strictly between 0 and 1; any number outside that range, ``nan`` and ``inf`` included, is a ``ValueError``. It is only a target. The holdout is one whole fold of a split into ``max(2, round(1 / fraction))`` folds, itself capped at the number of distinct groups, so the realised share is quantised to whole groups and can miss in either direction, by a lot. Over eight equal groups, 0.05 holds out 0.125 (no finer split is available) and 0.7 holds out 0.5 (the two-fold floor); with one dominant group — 70 of 100 samples across four groups — those same two requests instead hold out 0.10 and 0.70. Whenever the realised share is further than ``max(0.01, 0.1 * validation_fraction)`` from the requested one, a ``UserWarning`` names both numbers and why they differ.

The holdout is one whole fold of a split into ``max(2, round(1 / fraction))`` folds, itself capped at the number of distinct groups, so the realised share is quantised to whole groups and can miss in either direction, by a lot. Over eight equal groups, 0.05 holds out 0.125 (no finer split is available) and 0.7 holds out 0.5 (the two-fold floor); with one dominant group — 70 of 100 samples across four groups — those same two requests instead hold out 0.10 and 0.70. Whenever the realised share is further than ``max(0.01, 0.1 * validation_fraction)`` from the requested one, a ``UserWarning`` names both numbers and why they differ.
records.translation: Proporción objetivo de muestras que se reservan, estrictamente entre 0 y 1; cualquier número fuera de ese rango, incluidos ``nan`` e ``inf``, es un ``ValueError``. Es solo un objetivo. La reserva es una partición completa de una división en ``max(2, round(1 / fraction))`` particiones, limitada a su vez al número de grupos distintos, de modo que la proporción obtenida se cuantiza en grupos completos y puede desviarse en cualquier sentido, y mucho. Con ocho grupos iguales, 0.05 reserva 0.125 (no hay división más fina disponible) y 0.7 reserva 0.5 (el mínimo de dos particiones); con un grupo dominante — 70 de 100 muestras repartidas en cuatro grupos — esas mismas dos solicitudes reservan en cambio 0.10 y 0.70. Siempre que la proporción obtenida se aleje de la solicitada más de ``max(0.01, 0.1 * validation_fraction)``, un ``UserWarning`` indica ambos números y por qué difieren.

records.context: The enhancement chain follows the same route. Make Masks' chain (:mod:`spacr.qt.detect_chain`) is written into a settings file as the ``enhance_*`` structured-data names and read back here by :func:`prepare_chain`, with the ``psf_*`` settings folded in as the chain's PSF stage, so one plate run applies exactly the steps a curator tuned, in the chain's own order: background, PSF, denoise, contrast, sharpen. The session applies it per selected channel at the stage the PSF already ran -- after illumination correction and before normalization -- and its provenance goes into the same ``psf/segmentation_application.json`` record, so a changed chain is refused on resume the way a changed kernel is. With no chain step on, a processing session is byte for byte what it was before the chain existed.
records.label: spacr.psf_pipeline#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The enhancement chain follows the same route. Make Masks' chain (:mod:`spacr.qt.detect_chain`) is written into a settings file as the ``enhance_*`` keys and read back here by :func:`prepare_chain`, with the ``psf_*`` settings folded in as the chain's PSF stage, so one plate run applies exactly the steps a curator tuned, in the chain's own order: background, PSF, denoise, contrast, sharpen. The session applies it per selected channel at the stage the PSF already ran -- after illumination correction and before normalization -- and its provenance goes into the same ``psf/segmentation_application.json`` record, so a changed chain is refused on resume the way a changed kernel is. With no chain step on, a run is byte for byte what it was before the chain existed.
records.translation: La cadena de realce sigue el mismo camino. La cadena de Make Masks (:mod:`spacr.qt.detect_chain`) se escribe en un archivo de ajustes como las claves ``enhance_*`` y aquí la vuelve a leer :func:`prepare_chain`, con los ajustes ``psf_*`` incorporados como etapa PSF de la cadena, de modo que la ejecución de una placa aplica exactamente los pasos que ajustó un curador, en el orden propio de la cadena: fondo, PSF, eliminación de ruido, contraste, nitidez. La sesión la aplica a cada canal seleccionado en la etapa en la que ya se ejecutaba la PSF -- después de la corrección de iluminación y antes de la normalización -- y su procedencia se guarda en el mismo registro ``psf/segmentation_application.json``, de modo que una cadena modificada se rechaza al reanudar igual que un kernel modificado. Sin ningún paso de la cadena activado, una ejecución es byte a byte la misma que antes de que existiera la cadena.

records.source: A run used to decode exactly three barcodes -- a plate column, a guide and a plate row -- because the regex, the settings and the read processors each spelled all three of them out by name. An entry is that same information written once, so that a screen carrying a fourth barcode, or only one, is a different collection of entries rather than a different code path.
records.translation: Antes, una ejecución decodificaba exactamente tres códigos de barras -- una columna de la placa, una guía y una fila de la placa -- porque la expresión regular, los ajustes y los procesadores de lecturas nombraban explícitamente los tres. records.source: A settings file names its barcodes under ``barcode_set``, as a list with one entry per barcode. An entry is a mapping of the fields of :class:`BarcodeEntry`, or just a name when the reference table for that name is already in the settings. An entry that names no reference table takes the one under its own name followed by ``_csv``, and failing that the reference of that name spaCR ships, so adding a fourth barcode to the three that ship is a one-entry addition rather than a re-declaration of all four.
records.translation: Un archivo de ajustes nombra sus códigos de barras bajo ``barcode_set``, como una lista con una entrada por código de barras. Una entrada es una correspondencia de los campos de :class:`BarcodeEntry`, o solo un nombre cuando la tabla de referencia de ese nombre ya está en los ajustes. Una entrada que no nombra ninguna tabla de referencia toma la que figura bajo su propio nombre seguido de ``_csv`` y, si no existe, la referencia de ese nombre que incluye spaCR, de modo que añadir un cuarto código de barras a los tres incluidos es añadir una entrada y no volver a declarar los cuatro.

records.context: An entry named after one of the three barcodes spaCR shipped keeps the spellings that barcode has always had, for every field the settings file does not spell out itself. That is what makes a set of those three the processing session they describe rather than a re-implementation of it: the same regex groups, the same output columns, and the same order of the count table. A barcode named anything else derives its spellings from its own name.

records.translation: Una entrada con el nombre de uno de los tres códigos de barras que incluía spaCR conserva las grafías que ese código de barras ha tenido siempre, para cada campo que el archivo de ajustes no indique explícitamente. Eso es lo que hace que un conjunto de esos tres sea la ejecución que describen y no una reimplementación de ella: los mismos grupos de la expresión regular, las mismas columnas de salida y el mismo orden de la tabla de recuentos. Un código de barras con cualquier otro nombre deriva sus grafías de su propio nombre.

records.context: Run plaque, recruitment, invasion, and replication assays.
records.label: spacr.submodules#0
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Run plaque, recruitment, invasion, and replication assays.
records.translation: Ejecuta ensayos de placas de lisis, reclutamiento, invasión y replicación.

records.context: Four spaCR tiles currently share this landing page, but they answer different biological questions.  :func:`analyze_plaques` segments plaque images and summarizes plaque number and area.  :func:`analyze_recruitment` measures a fluorescent marker around pathogens or vacuoles relative to host cytoplasm. :func:`analyze_invasion` uses differential pre/post-permeabilization staining to classify parasites as attached outside or invaded inside a host cell. :func:`analyze_replication` counts parasites within each parasitophorous vacuole and compares the resulting replication-state distributions.  Cellpose training, testing, and model-application utilities also live here, but they are not substitutes for those four assay entry points.
records.label: spacr.submodules#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Four spaCR tiles currently share this landing page, but they answer different biological questions.  :func:`analyze_plaques` segments plaque images and summarizes plaque number and area.  :func:`analyze_recruitment` measures a fluorescent marker around pathogens or vacuoles relative to host cytoplasm. :func:`analyze_invasion` uses differential pre/post-permeabilization staining to classify parasites as attached outside or invaded inside a host cell. :func:`analyze_replication` counts parasites within each parasitophorous vacuole and compares the resulting replication-state distributions.  Cellpose training, testing, and model-application utilities also live here, but they are not substitutes for those four assay entry points.
records.translation: Cuatro mosaicos de spaCR comparten actualmente esta página de inicio, pero responden a preguntas biológicas distintas.  :func:`analyze_plaques` segmenta imágenes de placas de lisis y resume el número y el área de las placas.  :func:`analyze_recruitment` mide un marcador fluorescente alrededor de patógenos o vacuolas en relación con el citoplasma del hospedador. :func:`analyze_invasion` usa una tinción diferencial antes y después de la permeabilización para clasificar los parásitos como adheridos por fuera o invasores dentro de una célula hospedadora. :func:`analyze_replication` cuenta los parásitos dentro de cada vacuola parasitófora y compara las distribuciones resultantes de estados de replicación.  Aquí también están las utilidades de entrenamiento, prueba y aplicación de modelos de Cellpose, pero no sustituyen a esos cuatro puntos de entrada de ensayos.

records.context: For plaques, inspect the masks before interpreting counts or areas.  For Recruitment, verify the object filters, condition annotation, and per-microplate sample position denominators before comparing treatments.  For Invasion, review microscope field of view-level thresholds, control agreement, bimodality, and sensitivity flags before using the efficiency table.  For Replication, inspect the vacuole grouping and the reported non-power-of-two fraction before comparing doubling distributions. Follow the specific function links above until the four microscope image fields receive separate API destinations.
records.label: spacr.submodules#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: For plaques, inspect the masks before interpreting counts or areas.  For Recruitment, verify the object filters, condition annotation, and per-well denominators before comparing treatments.  For Invasion, review field-level thresholds, control agreement, bimodality, and sensitivity flags before using the efficiency table.  For Replication, inspect the vacuole grouping and the reported non-power-of-two fraction before comparing doubling distributions. Follow the specific function links above until the four tiles receive separate API destinations.
records.translation: En el caso de las placas de lisis, inspeccione las máscaras antes de interpretar recuentos o áreas.  En Recruitment, verifique los filtros de objetos, la anotación de condiciones y los denominadores por pocillo antes de comparar tratamientos.  En Invasion, revise los umbrales por campo, la concordancia de los controles, la bimodalidad y los indicadores de sensibilidad antes de usar la tabla de eficiencia.  En Replication, inspeccione la agrupación de vacuolas y la fracción indicada de valores que no son potencias de dos antes de comparar distribuciones de duplicación. Siga los enlaces a las funciones concretas indicados arriba hasta que los cuatro mosaicos tengan destinos de API independientes.

records.context: **Statistics use the microplate sample position as the unit of replication.** Parasites within a microplate sample position share a coverslip, an antibody bath and a focal image layer, so they are not independent; the reported test is a Mann-Whitney U on the per-microplate sample position efficiencies. A pooled-parasite chi-squared is reported beside it purely so its inflation is visible. See :func:`_invasion_compare_conditions`.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#10
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Statistics use the well as the unit of replication.** Parasites within a well share a coverslip, an antibody bath and a focal plane, so they are not independent; the reported test is a Mann-Whitney U on the per-well efficiencies. A pooled-parasite chi-squared is reported beside it purely so its inflation is visible. See :func:`_invasion_compare_conditions`.
records.translation: **La estadística usa el pocillo como unidad de replicación.** Los parásitos de un mismo pocillo comparten cubreobjetos, baño de anticuerpo y plano focal, así que no son independientes; la prueba que se indica es una U de Mann-Whitney sobre las eficiencias por pocillo. Junto a ella se indica una chi cuadrado con los parásitos agrupados únicamente para que su inflación sea visible. Véase :func:`_invasion_compare_conditions`.

records.context: The design follows from this asymmetry. "Inside" is defined by an absence, and absence is the unreliable direction. Poor antibody penetration, a focal image layer off the parasite's equator, photobleaching, a low-expressing parasite — every one of them removes outside signal from a parasite that is outside, and every one of them therefore *inflates* invasion efficiency. Nothing plausible pushes the error the other way. The threshold on the outside image data channel is the single number the assay rests on, so it is derived from the data, reported per microscope field of view in ``fields``, cross-checked against a control-derived cut when one exists, and bracketed by a sensitivity pair that says how much of the answer is the threshold.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The design follows from this asymmetry. "Inside" is defined by an absence, and absence is the unreliable direction. Poor antibody penetration, a focal plane off the parasite's equator, photobleaching, a low-expressing parasite — every one of them removes outside signal from a parasite that is outside, and every one of them therefore *inflates* invasion efficiency. Nothing plausible pushes the error the other way. The threshold on the outside channel is the single number the assay rests on, so it is derived from the data, reported per field in ``fields``, cross-checked against a control-derived cut when one exists, and bracketed by a sensitivity pair that says how much of the answer is the threshold.
records.translation: El diseño se deriva de esta asimetría. "Inside" (dentro) se define por una ausencia, y la ausencia es la dirección poco fiable. Una mala penetración del anticuerpo, un plano focal alejado del ecuador del parásito, el fotoblanqueo, un parásito con baja expresión — cada uno de ellos elimina señal exterior de un parásito que está fuera, y por tanto cada uno de ellos *infla* la eficiencia de invasión. Nada plausible desplaza el error en sentido contrario. El umbral del canal exterior es el único número en el que se basa el ensayo, por lo que se deriva de los datos, se indica por campo en ``fields``, se contrasta con un corte derivado de los controles cuando existe y se acota con un par de sensibilidad que indica qué parte de la respuesta se debe al umbral.

records.context: Three design decisions:
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three design decisions:
records.translation: Tres decisiones de diseño:

records.context: **The threshold is per microscope field of view.** Illumination and staining vary microscope field of view to microscope field of view, and a laboratory microplate-wide cut turns an illumination gradient into an invasion gradient. See :func:`_invasion_field_thresholds`.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The threshold is per field.** Illumination and staining vary field to field, and a plate-wide cut turns an illumination gradient into an invasion gradient. See :func:`_invasion_field_thresholds`.
records.translation: **El umbral es por campo.** La iluminación y la tinción varían de un campo a otro, y un corte común para toda la placa convierte un gradiente de iluminación en un gradiente de invasión. Véase :func:`_invasion_field_thresholds`.

records.context: **A threshold without two populations is arbitrary.** Otsu splits a single smear of signal down the middle and return a confident number. ``bimodality_coefficient`` and ``qc_flag_unimodal`` say when that has happened, per microscope field of view and per microplate sample position, instead of letting it pass silently. See :func:`_bimodality_coefficient`.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A threshold without two populations is arbitrary.** Otsu splits a single smear of signal down the middle and return a confident number. ``bimodality_coefficient`` and ``qc_flag_unimodal`` say when that has happened, per field and per well, instead of letting it pass silently. See :func:`_bimodality_coefficient`.
records.translation: **Un umbral sin dos poblaciones es arbitrario.** Otsu divide por la mitad una única distribución continua de señal y devuelve un número con aparente seguridad. ``bimodality_coefficient`` y ``qc_flag_unimodal`` indican cuándo ha ocurrido, por campo y por pocillo, en lugar de dejarlo pasar sin aviso. Véase :func:`_bimodality_coefficient`.

records.context: ``invasion_efficiency = n_invaded / (n_invaded + n_attached)`` and it is always reported next to ``n_total``: 90% from ten parasites and 90% from four thousand are not the same result. A microplate sample position that scored nothing gets NaN, not 0.0.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``invasion_efficiency = n_invaded / (n_invaded + n_attached)`` and it is always reported next to ``n_total``: 90% from ten parasites and 90% from four thousand are not the same result. A well that scored nothing gets NaN, not 0.0.
records.translation: ``invasion_efficiency = n_invaded / (n_invaded + n_attached)``, y siempre se indica junto a ``n_total``: un 90% a partir de diez parásitos y un 90% a partir de cuatro mil no son el mismo resultado. Un pocillo en el que no se clasificó nada obtiene NaN, no 0.0.

records.context: *Toxoplasma gondii* replicates by endodyogeny, two daughters forming inside a mother, so a parasitophorous vacuole holds 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 parasites — a power of two. The readout of a replication assay is therefore the **distribution** of parasites-per-vacuole across a microplate sample position, not a mean: a mean of 3.2 cannot distinguish "everything at 3-ish", which is biologically impossible, from a healthy mix of 2s and 4s. A drug that slows replication moves mass from the 8 and 4 buckets down into 2 and 1, and only the distribution shows that.

records.source: *Toxoplasma gondii* replicates by endodyogeny, two daughters forming inside a mother, so a parasitophorous vacuole holds 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 parasites — a power of two. The readout of a replication assay is therefore the **distribution** of parasites-per-vacuole across a well, not a mean: a mean of 3.2 cannot distinguish "everything at 3-ish", which is biologically impossible, from a healthy mix of 2s and 4s. A drug that slows replication moves mass from the 8 and 4 buckets down into 2 and 1, and only the distribution shows that.
records.translation: *Toxoplasma gondii* se replica por endodiogenia, con dos hijas que se forman dentro de una madre, de modo que una vacuola parasitófora contiene 1, 2, 4, 8 o 16 parásitos — una potencia de dos. Por tanto, la lectura de un ensayo de replicación es la **distribución** de parásitos por vacuola en un pocillo, no una media: una media de 3.2 no permite distinguir "everything at 3-ish" (todo en torno a 3), que es biológicamente imposible, de una mezcla sana de vacuolas de 2 y de 4. Un fármaco que ralentiza la replicación desplaza masa de las clases de 8 y 4 hacia las de 2 y 1, y solo la distribución lo muestra.

records.context: **The counting unit is the vacuole.** Not the parasite, and not the host cell — one host cell routinely carries several vacuoles, so grouping on ``cell_id`` reports their combined count as a single vacuole and produces a plausible but meaningless number. See :func:`_assign_vacuole_ids` for how the vacuole is derived and what each ``vacuole_key`` costs you.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_replication#3

records.source: **The counting unit is the vacuole.** Not the parasite, and not the host cell — one host cell routinely carries several vacuoles, so grouping on ``cell_id`` reports their combined count as a single vacuole and produces a plausible but meaningless number. See :func:`_assign_vacuole_ids` for how the vacuole is derived and what each ``vacuole_key`` costs you.
records.translation: **La unidad de recuento es la vacuola.** No el parásito ni la célula hospedadora — una célula hospedadora contiene a menudo varias vacuolas, de modo que agrupar por ``cell_id`` indica su recuento combinado como si fuera una sola vacuola y produce un número plausible pero sin sentido. Véase :func:`_assign_vacuole_ids` para saber cómo se deriva la vacuola y qué implica cada ``vacuole_key``.

records.context: Rosettes of 3, 5, 6 or 7 are counted into an explicit ``non_power_of_two`` bucket that is always reported and never folded into a neighbouring bucket. That bucket is the assay's own quality control: a microplate sample position where 30% of vacuoles are off the power-of-two ladder has a segmentation problem, and its replication number should not be trusted.

records.source: Rosettes of 3, 5, 6 or 7 are counted into an explicit ``non_power_of_two`` bucket that is always reported and never folded into a neighbouring bucket. records.translation: Las rosetas de 3, 5, 6 o 7 se cuentan en una clase explícita ``non_power_of_two`` que siempre se indica y nunca se fusiona con una clase vecina. Esa clase es el propio control de calidad del ensayo: un pocillo en el que el 30% de las vacuolas queda fuera de la escala de potencias de dos tiene un problema de segmentación, y su cifra de replicación no es fiable.

records.source: This is a separate pass rather than a branch inside the segmenter because the two shapes of input differ in what a result row means. One field per image gives one row per image; a plate gives one row per well, and the well has to be named or the conditions are pooled into a single meaningless count. Splitting first makes every downstream row a well, whichever shape arrived.
records.translation: Es una pasada independiente y no una rama dentro del segmentador porque las dos formas de entrada difieren en lo que significa una fila de resultados. Un campo por imagen da una fila por imagen; una placa da una fila por pocillo, y el pocillo tiene que tener nombre o las condiciones se agrupan en un único recuento sin sentido. Dividir primero hace que cada fila posterior sea un pocillo, sea cual sea la forma de la entrada.

records.context: An image in which the detector finds nothing is copied into the split folder whole, with no geometry, so it is still analysed but has no scale. Without the copy, when some images in a folder split and others did not, the others would contribute no extracted image region and no row. The function returns ``src`` unchanged only when detection is off or finds nothing in any image.

records.translation: Una imagen en la que el detector no encuentra nada se copia entera en la carpeta de división, sin geometría, de modo que se sigue analizando pero no tiene escala. Sin esa copia, cuando algunas imágenes de una carpeta se dividieran y otras no, estas últimas no aportarían ni recorte ni fila. La función devuelve ``src`` sin cambios solo cuando la detección está desactivada o no encuentra nada en ninguna imagen.

records.context: Derived: memory is reported as a lower bound -- ``n_jobs`` workers each holding one field is the least the processing session can use, before a single working copy. A lower bound still catches cases such as eight workers holding a 900 MB field each on a 16 GB laptop. The measured peak is what :func:`spacr.benchmark.benchmark` reports, and this card says so rather than inventing a multiplier for it.
records.label: spacr.validate.describe_resources#6

records.source: Derived: memory is reported as a lower bound -- ``n_jobs`` workers each holding one field is the least the run can use, before a single working copy. A lower bound still catches cases such as eight workers holding a 900 MB field each on a 16 GB laptop. The measured peak is what :func:`spacr.benchmark.benchmark` reports, and this card says so rather than inventing a multiplier for it.
records.translation: Derivado: la memoria se indica como cota inferior -- ``n_jobs`` workers que contienen un campo cada uno es lo mínimo que puede usar la ejecución, antes de una sola copia de trabajo. Una cota inferior detecta igualmente casos como ocho workers con un campo de 900 MB cada uno en un portátil de 16 GB. El pico medido es lo que informa :func:`spacr.benchmark.benchmark`, y esta ficha lo indica en lugar de inventar un multiplicador para él.

records.source: Not estimated: the size of the PNG crop tree. It is objects times crop modes, and the object count is what the run measures. The card names it as unbounded rather than producing a number that would be wrong by an order of magnitude either way.
records.translation: No estimado: el tamaño del árbol de recortes PNG. Es el número de objetos por los modos de recorte, y el número de objetos es lo que mide la ejecución. La ficha lo indica como no acotado en lugar de dar un número que sería erróneo en un orden de magnitud en cualquier sentido.
